title: tabernaemontana panamensis
intro: Tabernaemontana panamensis, commonly known as Panam Stick, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits, which include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tabernaemontana panamensis include analgesic and antipyretic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, such as voacangine and voacristine, and other compounds like saponins and terpenoids. Further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and potential applications of Tabernaemontana panamensis in modern medicine.
